choose.when: SELECT u.id as id, u.nickname as nickname, u.video_num as videoNum, u.face as face, COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) as fansCounts, 0 as videoNumCount FROM users u LEFT JOIN fans f ON u.id = f.vloger_id WHERE (u.is_deleted = 0 OR u.is_deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname, u.video_num, u.face ORDER BY fansCounts DESC LIMIT #{paramMap.limit}
choose.otherwise: SELECT u.id as id, u.nickname as nickname, u.video_num as videoNum, u.face as face, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) as videoNumCount, 0 as fansCounts FROM users u LEFT JOIN vlog v ON u.id = v.vloger_id AND (v.is_deleted = 0 OR v.is_deleted IS NULL) WHERE (u.is_deleted = 0 OR u.is_deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY u.id, u.nickname, u.video_num, u.face ORDER BY videoNumCount DESC LIMIT #{paramMap.limit}

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(v.id), 0) as videoCount FROM ( SELECT 1 as month UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12 ) months LEFT JOIN vlog v ON MONTH(v.created_time) = months.month AND YEAR(v.created_time) = #{year} AND (v.is_deleted = 0 OR v.is_deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY months.month ORDER BY months.month ASC
